تنتزعوا (form VIII)
# تَنْتَزِعُوا (tantaziʕū) /tan.ta.zi.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
# تُنْتَزَعُوا (tuntazaʕū) /tun.ta.za.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
